Subject: Evaluation sample conveyance — initial manifest and ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency and cost examples were helpful. We want to move forward with a short evaluation (MAP + test run) to validate Redwood in our checkout personalization pipeline.

Attached is a first-pass manifest (BrightRetail_sample_manifest.csv) showing ~12k anonymized sessions we can share under limited use. Quick asks to get the MAP rolling:
- Can Redwood accept an ephemeral dataset transfer with strict retention (destroy after 30 days)?
- We need a mutual action plan with milestones: dataset ingestion, smoke test, 1-week run, post-run qualitative review. Target start: 2027-08-24.
- Any mandatory access constraints or sandbox environment requirements?

We’re ready to sign the standard MPA/NDA if you send it over. I’ve cc'd Kate (security) and Sana (PM).

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Data Platform | BrightRetail

Hi Liam — great to hear and glad the demo was useful.

High level response and proposed MAP attached (redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf):
1) Dataset handling: we can accept an ephemeral transfer to a dedicated sandbox in Redwood Private (VPC peering) or to a hosted, isolated bucket. By default we support 30-day retention and a verified destruction workflow; we’ll include a takedown certificate.
2) Proposed milestone schedule (we can tighten if you need):
   • Day 0 (2027-08-24) — Dataset ingest + schema validation
   • Day 1–2 — Smoke tests on 10% sample
   • Day 3–9 — Full 7-day run with production-like load profile
   • Day 10 — Post-run evaluation and qualitative review meeting
3) Access constraints: strict read-only keys, role-limited users, no copies outside sandbox; telemetry limited to aggregated metrics for quality checks.

Attachments in this message: redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), usage_constraints_table.xlsx (constraints & allowed operations).

Next steps: if you can countersign the one-page MAP and return NDA (we received your signed NDA in a separate channel — thanks), we’ll schedule ingest for 08/24 and provision keys.

Looping in Rishi (legal) and Aditya (solutions) to confirm scope and cost ceilings for the run.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick legal/controls notes:
- Confirming BrightRetail has redacted PII from the manifest per our onboarding checklist. Please attach the redaction attestations before ingest.
- Usage constraints we need to explicitly capture in the MAP: permitted operations (scoring, diagnostics), prohibited ops (retrain, model extraction), retention window (30 days), and destruction verification.
- If BrightRetail requires additional audit logs retained >30 days for their compliance, that’s a counterparty request we need to surface (we can offer limited retention within the VPC on request).

I’ve attached a short redline doc within the MAP draft (sent into the Drive folder) and a template clause for "ephemeral sample handling" we recommend.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Hi Rishi / Kimberly — thanks for the clear list. Confirmations from our side:
- Manifest contains session ids, hashed user ids, event timestamps; no raw payment/token PII. We will attach a short attestation PDF before transfer.
- We accept the usage constraints as written (scoring + diagnostics only).
- On audit log retention: we will accept logs retained by Redwood for 30 days. We do not need longer retention beyond the MAP period.

One timeline ask: can we compress ingest + smoke to Day 0–1 and start the 7-day run on 08/25 so the post-run review falls into the first week of sept? We have exec availability on 08/31 for the review.

Sana

- 7-day run: 2027-08-25 through 2027-08-31.
- Post-run review: 2027-08-31 (exec review, 30–45 min).
- Constraints: scoring + diagnostics only; no model training; 30-day retention; destruction certificate to be provided.
- Deliverables from BrightRetail: BrightRetail_sample_manifest.csv, BrightRetail_redaction_attestation.pdf, signed one-page MAP (we’ll provide signature block).
- Deliverables from Redwood: provisioning keys, sandbox endpoint, ingestion report, destruction certificate after takedown.

I’ve uploaded the signed MAP stub to the Drive link and attached the draft map in this thread for visibility. If that all looks good I will schedule the ingestion slot and have Aditya run the initial smoke.
